prompt:
Use the reference image for: the same big round dark iron hotpot (single pot, no dividers), the same warm tungsten restaurant lighting, and especially the SAME character design of the dried red chili characters and the Sichuan peppercorn characters (googly eyes with white eyeballs and black pupils, small simple mouths with no teeth, tiny arms and legs made of their own material). New shot: photorealistic cinematic food-character close-up, vertical 9:16, camera low and close, just above the surface of the pot, looking across the bubbling red broth with part of the iron pot rim visible at the edges. The beef-tallow base has fully melted: the pot is full of glossy deep-red chili oil broth at a rolling boil, big bubbles bursting, steam rising. A party is happening on the broth: one dried red chili character surfs on top of a big bubble with arms spread wide, laughing; another chili floats on its back doing a lazy backstroke with a happy face; three tiny Sichuan peppercorn characters bounce high into the air off a bursting bubble like on a trampoline, joyful open-mouth smiles; two chili characters in the foreground give each other a high five, splashing red oil droplets. Everyone is excited and having fun. Realistic dried chili skin texture and peppercorn husk texture, glistening oil highlights, shallow depth of field, warm red and amber tones, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No humans, no utensils, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
